name: WAHA | WhatsApp HTTP API (GOWS Engine) for n8n, Chatwoot and Bots
description: WhatsApp HTTP API: GOWS engine, sessions survive redeploys, locked down
card_desc: WAHA: a self-hosted WhatsApp HTTP API. Send and receive messages from n8n, Chatwoot or your own code over REST and webhooks, on the lightweight GOWS engine with sessions kept on a volume.
